integration.title: How it integrates
integration.subtitle: The embedded SDK model, validated in production
integration.modelText: The verification code runs inside the partner's app, not in a third-party app that monitors from the outside. The sensitive session is managed locally, and blocking decisions are made on the partner's server side.
integration.proofText: Currently in production on UniPay (unipay-app), protecting real withdrawals, deposits, and transfers. Each sensitive transaction is preceded by an active session verification.
integration.step1: The user opens a sensitive action (withdraw, deposit, transfer) — a security session starts automatically.
integration.step2: If the user leaves the app, the session is suspended with a short tolerance (30 seconds).
integration.step3: Beyond the tolerance, the session is invalidated — the action is blocked server-side until the user re-verifies.
integration.step4: Quick cognitive re-verification (the same tests as the demo) — once validated server-side, the transaction is unblocked.
